components.name: RangeSlider
components.description: A dual-thumb range control representing lower and upper numeric bounds, built on two overlapping native range inputs with a custom track and fill visualization (R §1). g13.006's stateful proof: 18 web props, 8 data-* attributes, two-thumb anatomy, unipolar/bipolar fill geometry, and a machine pinned by the shared slider conformance vector (RNG-01..29).

props.name: variant
props.description: Native-input control or dense composite control (R §3, RNG-03).

props.name: polarity
props.description: Ordinary range or an explicit bipolar center reference (R §3, RNG-04).

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Bipolar reference; null defaults to zero when zero is inside the range, otherwise the midpoint (R §3, RNG-05).

props.name: law
props.description: Embedded-variant value mapping; default { type: "linear" } — an opaque payload whose default object literal no Value variant can carry, so the default is recorded as None and named here (R §3; b041 vocabulary-note pattern).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout and interaction axis (R §3/§7, RNG-07; CROSS-11).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and applies disabled opacity (R §3, RNG-08).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Base accessible name; per-thumb labels append "minimum"/"maximum" (R §3/§6, RNG-10).

props.name: lowerValueText
props.description: Human-readable text for the lower thumb (aria-valuetext) (R §3, RNG-10).

props.name: upperValueText
props.description: Human-readable text for the upper thumb (aria-valuetext) (R §3, RNG-10).

props.name: size
props.description: Explicit control-size override; default null — resolves from inherited presentation plus sizeRole (R §3, RNG-06; CROSS-07).

props.name: sizeRole
props.description: Semantic size offset from inherited presentation (R §3, RNG-06; CROSS-07).

props.name: density
props.description: Explicit density override; default null — inherited from presentation (R §3, RNG-09; CROSS-08).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: React uncontrolled seed; the value pair is controlled-wins (value !== undefined), so the pair is recorded through the props rather than the DoNotMix controlled_state (R §3 controlled/uncontrolled; CROSS-03 web-only idiom, CROSS-04).

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Either thumb changes value during interaction; the pair is reported together and lower <= upper is preserved (R §5, RNG-11).

events.name: onValueCommit
events.description: Interaction finishes on either thumb (mouseup/touchend/keyup commit) (R §5, RNG-11).

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Range slider host with relative positioning; role="group" (R §2, RNG-14).

parts.name: Track
parts.description: Full available range background bar (R §2, RNG-14).

parts.name: Negative Fill
parts.description: Bipolar selected-fill segment on the negative side of the center reference; empty in unipolar (R §2/§8, RNG-16).

parts.name: Positive Fill
parts.description: Selected-fill segment on the positive side of the center reference — the whole window in unipolar (R §2/§8, RNG-16).

parts.name: Center
parts.description: Bipolar center reference marker; hidden in unipolar and in the standard variant (R §2/§8).

parts.name: Control

identified.description: The two standard-variant thumbs, each with its own identity and declared semantics (R §2, RNG-14/15).

parts.description: The identified pair of standard-variant thumb controls; the count and the identities come from the definition (g13.018 R5).

conditional-documented.description: Native range input for the lower thumb (R §2, RNG-14/15).
Native range input for the upper thumb (R §2, RNG-14/15).

Adapter-owned slider focus stop for the upper thumb (R §2/§6, RNG-15).

attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: The orientation value; always emitted; styling hook only, not exposed to assistive technology (R §9, RNG-17).

attributes.name: data-disabled

attributes.name: data-variant

attributes.name: data-polarity

attributes.name: data-fill-split
attributes.description: Whether both fill segments meet at the center, so renderers square only the touching corners; always emitted (R §4/§8, RNG-16/17).

attributes.name: data-state

attributes.name: data-size

attributes.name: data-density

attributes.name: --poodle-range-start
attributes.description: Fill start position, from the lower thumb's normalized value (R §3, RNG-17).

attributes.name: --poodle-range-end
attributes.description: Fill end position, from the upper thumb's normalized value (R §3, RNG-17).

attributes.name: --poodle-range-negative-start
attributes.description: Negative segment start — which side of the origin the negative fill grows from (R §3, RNG-17).

attributes.name: --poodle-range-negative-span

ladder.description: Extra-small rung: min-height 1.25rem, track 0.1875rem, thumb 0.75rem (R §8, RNG-09).
Small rung: min-height 1.375rem, track 0.25rem, thumb 0.875rem (R §8, RNG-09).
Default rung: min-height 1.5rem, track 0.375rem, thumb 1rem (R §8, RNG-09).
Large rung: min-height 1.625rem, track 0.5rem, thumb 1.125rem (R §8, RNG-09).
Extra-large rung: min-height 1.75rem, track 0.625rem, thumb 1.25rem (R §8, RNG-09).

adjustments.description: Compact adds 0.25rem vertical hit-area padding to the root — the documented §8 exception: density grows the grabbable margin without changing track, thumb, or visual min-height (R §8, RNG-09).
Comfortable adds 0.75rem vertical hit-area padding to the root (R §8, RNG-09).

tokens.description: Negative fill segment — the bipolar side of the origin (R §8).

recipe_hooks.description: Track background; surface 88% color-mix base (R §8, RNG-21).
Negative selected-fill segment — the bipolar side of the origin (R §8, RNG-21; the acceptance line 'negative/positive fill geometry and recipe roles remain exact').
Standard-variant control fill; transparent in the embedded variant (R §8, RNG-21).
Native input runnable-track fill; transparent (R §8, RNG-21).
Thumb shadow — a black 18% color-mix with no single semantic token; the elevated fallback names the family (R §8, RNG-21).
Focus ring for controls and embedded stops (R §8, RNG-21).
Compound focus ring on the native thumb; focusRing 32% color-mix (R §8, RNG-21).

aria.description: Per-thumb accessible names append "minimum"/"maximum" to the base label, or default to "Minimum value"/"Maximum value" (R §6, RNG-10).
Lower bound on both inputs (R §6, RNG-10).
Upper bound on both inputs (R §6, RNG-10).
Lower value on the lower thumb, upper value on the upper thumb (R §6, RNG-10).
Required on the embedded slider focus stops — custom widgets with no implicit orientation; NOT set on the native range inputs (R §6, RNG-10).
Disabled state on the embedded focus stops (R §6, RNG-10).

native.name: disabled
native.description: Native disabled attribute on both inputs (R §6, RNG-10).

native.name: type
native.description: Native range input type on both controls (R §6, RNG-14).

native.name: min
native.description: Native min on both inputs; the lower input's max clamps to the upper value (R §3/§6, RNG-12).

native.name: max
native.description: Native max on both inputs; the upper input's min clamps to the lower value (R §3/§6, RNG-12).

native.name: step
native.description: Native step on both inputs (R §6, RNG-02).

accessibility.description: Group root with two related slider semantics; each thumb is individually focusable and distinguishable as lower or upper bound (R §6, RNG-10/14/15).

capabilities.purpose: Embedded-variant shared-root pointer capture — the full root is the pointer target and the gesture never transfers thumbs (R §3/§4, RNG-15).

runtimes.reason: The component's root calls setPointerCapture for the embedded variant and holds the gesture on the shared root (RNG-15).
The component's root calls setPointerCapture for the embedded variant and holds the gesture on the shared root (RNG-15).
The render's scrub overlay + the node-backend's drag system keep the gesture on the shared root for the whole drag (RNG-15; interaction.rs scrub handling).

Jetstream dispatches pointer presses to the render's scrub overlay but has no capture semantics — the embedded variant renders without a held gesture (RNG-15; measured g13.018: no capture vocabulary in the Jetstream sources).

capabilities.purpose: Per-thumb focus stops — Tab cycles lower, upper, and out (R §6, RNG-18/20).

runtimes.reason: The two native range inputs (standard) and the two slider focus stops (embedded) each carry their own tabindex (RNG-18/20).
The two native range inputs (standard) and the two slider focus stops (embedded) each carry their own tabIndex (RNG-18/20).
The render marks the root focusable and the node-backend observes focus and drives key dispatch for the focused element (interaction.rs; RNG-18/20).
The preview's focus system hit-tests and focuses the render's focusable root, and the adapter projects focus rings (main.rs focus handling, adapter render_structural.rs; RNG-18/20).

capabilities.purpose: Native grab overlay reports the pointer position as a fraction (Interaction::on_scrub); the component picks the nearer thumb on the press (R §3, RNG-13).

runtimes.reason: The shared root's pointer handlers report the position as a fraction and drive the machine's POINTER_BEGIN/MOVE/END (RNG-13).
The shared root's pointer handlers report the position as a fraction and drive the machine's POINTER_BEGIN/MOVE/END (RNG-13).
The render attaches on_scrub to the grab overlay and the node-backend reports the fraction across it, pressing and dragging (interaction.rs; RNG-13).

Jetstream renders the grab overlay but no pointer-fraction reporting reaches it — the component renders without scrub interaction (RNG-13; measured g13.018: no scrub vocabulary in the Jetstream sources).

keyboard.effect: Decrements the focused thumb by step through the machine — INPUT then COMMIT, preserving lower <= upper (R §6, RNG-18).
keyboard.description: Arrow Left/Down decrements the focused thumb (R §6, RNG-18).

keyboard.effect: Increments the focused thumb by step through the machine — INPUT then COMMIT, preserving lower <= upper (R §6, RNG-18).
keyboard.description: Arrow Right/Up increments the focused thumb (R §6, RNG-18).

keyboard.effect: Moves the focused thumb to min (lower thumb) or to the lower value (upper thumb) — the per-thumb Home bound (R §6, RNG-18).
keyboard.description: Home moves the focused thumb to its lower bound (R §6, RNG-18).

keyboard.effect: Moves the focused thumb to the upper value (lower thumb) or to max (upper thumb) — the per-thumb End bound (R §6, RNG-18).
keyboard.description: End moves the focused thumb to its upper bound (R §6, RNG-18).

keyboard.effect: Moves focus from the lower thumb to the upper thumb and onward (R §6, RNG-18/20).
keyboard.description: Tab moves focus between thumbs and out of the control (R §6, RNG-18).

keyboard.effect: Moves focus from the upper thumb to the lower thumb and backward (R §6, RNG-18/20).
keyboard.description: Shift+Tab moves focus backward through the thumbs (R §6, RNG-18).

fields.name: pointerActive

fields.name: activeThumb

fields.name: resolvedSize

fields.name: resolvedDensity

visual_state.description: The projection the shared machine computes (rangeSliderVisualState in core slider.ts; RangeSliderVisualState in contracts/headless slider.rs), which drawing consumes — geometry and gesture state, never machine internals (R §4; CROSS-14, RNG-16, IR-06).

extensions.reason: Vertical orientation is implemented natively rather than via CSS rotation (R §10/§12; RNG-26).
extensions.parity_effect: Same visual and interaction result by native means.

extensions.reason: The pair is the value; a host told about one thumb alone would have to remember the other, so Jetstream reports (low, high) together (R §10a; RNG-27).
extensions.parity_effect: Jetstream on_change/on_value_commit carry the pair, matching the web events' pair payload.

extensions.reason: Two overlapping native range inputs is the web DOM pattern; the native targets use a single grab overlay (R §12).
extensions.parity_effect: Same interaction and accessibility result from a different DOM pattern.

extensions.reason: poodle-node carries no orientation channel in its accessibility vocabulary, so neither native adapter can project the embedded aria-orientation today (R §12).
extensions.parity_effect: Embedded aria-orientation is absent on the native targets; a vertical embedded control announces as horizontal.
extensions.removal_condition: Lands with the orientation a11y field and native vertical orientation.

conformance_vectors.name: slider

steps.name: INPUT snaps and clamps
steps.description: INPUT normalizes the raw value — snap to step anchored at min, then clamp into [min, safeSliderMax] — and emits value-change (R §3/§5; machines.json slider entry 0).

steps.name: COMMIT clamps and emits
steps.description: COMMIT normalizes the same way and emits value-commit on release (R §3/§5; machines.json slider entry 1).

steps.name: SET_VALUE orders the pair
steps.description: SET_VALUE normalizes through normalizeRangeValue — the display pair is ordered and clamped (R §3, RNG-12).

steps.name: a thumb cannot cross its sibling
steps.description: Lower clamps to [min, upper], upper to [lower, max]; lower <= upper always holds (R §3, RNG-12).

steps.name: POINTER_BEGIN selects the nearer thumb
steps.description: Begin picks the thumb nearer the press fraction, holds it for the gesture, and the gesture never transfers (R §3/§4, RNG-12/13).

steps.name: POINTER_END commits the pair
steps.description: End emits value-commit with the pair and clears the active thumb (R §5, RNG-11).

steps.name: change during interaction, commit on release
steps.description: INPUT emits value-change; COMMIT/POINTER_END emits value-commit — the change/commit callback split (R §5, RNG-11).

conformance_vectors.description: The two-thumb slider machine semantics both web runtimes honor through the shared hand-written machines (slider.ts / slider.rs). Executable evidence: the `slider` key of packages/contracts/headless/vectors/machines.json — a fixed target that must pass unedited (R5).
